name: Facebook
headline: Connect evidence to conversation
strategy: Use native demonstrations, customer stories and FAQs. Pair prospecting concepts with a separate warm-audience hypothesis; exclude recent purchasers where appropriate.
gate: Meta Page permissions and account authority; no personal timeline automation.

name: Instagram
headline: Build a recognisable visual series
strategy: Adapt the same idea into a Reel storyboard, carousel outline and image. Test the opening hook and save-worthy educational content; use licensed audio and captions.
gate: Professional account and approved permissions; video and carousel execution remain a connector milestone.

name: WhatsApp
headline: Turn opted-in interest into service
strategy: Capture channel-specific consent. Use approved templates for outbound reminders and offers; handle opt-outs immediately. Separate transactional service from marketing.
metric: Delivered opted-in messages and qualified replies
gate: Cloud API messaging is not a public feed or WhatsApp Status publisher; templates and service windows apply.

name: YouTube
headline: Own a useful search topic
strategy: Create an original long-form explainer, then derive short clips with a clear next step. Test title and thumbnail separately from the story. Link to a relevant landing page.
metric: Watch time, retention and qualified visits
gate: OAuth upload scope, quota and processing verification; use resumable uploads in a separate media worker.

name: Snapchat
headline: Design for a vertical camera
strategy: Create fast vertical demonstrations with safe-area captions. Plan public Stories or Spotlight separately from Snap Ads. Test one product benefit per concept.
gate: Public Profile API allowlisting and profile-owned encrypted media upload are required.

name: LinkedIn
headline: Earn trust through expertise
strategy: Publish evidence-led case studies, founder perspectives and useful document outlines. Measure qualified business enquiries; do not automate unsolicited mass messages.
gate: Company Pages need Community Management access and organisation authority; existing adapter is member-only.

name: TikTok
headline: Make the product part of a story
strategy: Brief creators around a customer problem and a visible demonstration. Test different reasons to buy, not only new thumbnails. Preserve creator disclosure and music rights.
metric: Watch retention and incremental new customers
gate: Direct Post requires creator-info UI, user-selected privacy and explicit consent; unaudited clients are restricted.

name: Blogging
headline: Turn expertise into durable demand
strategy: Build topic clusters with original proof, author details and useful internal links. Repurpose each article into platform-native posts. Review facts and use canonical URLs.
metric: Qualified organic visits and assisted pipeline
gate: Included headless releases publish to your own site; external WordPress and other CMS adapters require connection work.
